name: zmath_mat_load_current_from
description: zMath::MatLoadCurrentFrom loads the current 4x3 matrix from a source buffer and clears the current identity flag.
known_limits: VC5SP3 profile vc5_o2_ob0_md_facs under local manifest zmath_mat_current_accessors verifies this helper with zero unmasked byte mismatches after COFF relocation masking.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja disassembly for 0x473250 copies 12 dwords from the ECX source into *g_currentMatrixPtrSlot and writes zero to *g_currentMatrixIdentityFlagSlot.
The native smoke verifies loaded matrix values through MatCopyCurrentTo and confirms the identity flag is cleared.
